PROPERTIES.clue_custom_text2: Each Habitat had at least one Zookeeper in it.
PROPERTIES.solution_text_EN_0: Block col 14-15-16 in Bear Habitat. This sets N in Croc Habitat.
PROPERTIES.solution_text_EN_1: No Habitat is empty.  So only M+K and Killer+V are together.
PROPERTIES.solution_text_EN_2: This sets J in C7. This isolates E. This isolates G, then L, then J.

PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: (D) is in the Main Area and (B) is in Concessions. No Visitor can be in a Habitat per the general clue, so (G) and (H) can only be alone on the Deck and in the Entrance, in either order. Also, (B) and someone else are in Concessions. So no one can occupy the Bear Habitat in C14, C15 and C16, block these squares. (N) can only be beside a tree in the Crocodile Habitat.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: No Habitat is empty, and there are five Habitats remaining. So only (M) + (K) and (V) + the murderer are together, and the other Zookeepers must be alone in a Habitat. So (J) cannot be with (N). This sets (J) in C8, either in the Penguin Habitat or the Elephant Habitat. Block the rest of C8.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Where can (E) be? C2 is already taken by (M), and either (G) or (H) is alone in the Entrance. (E) can only be beside a table in R10 C14, this isolates (E). This isolates (G), sitting in a chair alone on the Deck. Block the rest of the Deck.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: (L) cannot be with (N) (see hint 2). This isolates (L) on the last water square not beside an animal. This isolates (J) in the Elephant Habitat, then (B), then (N) and (H). This isolates (O) on the last available square beside a boulder.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: (I) cannot be with (L), (N), (J) or (O) (see hint 2). Per the general clue, (A) is in the Main Area, and he is also one row north of (I). So (I) can only be beside the lion in R4 C5, with (A) in R3 C7. This isolates (K).
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: (C) and (D) must be in R5 and R6. This isolates (F) beside the last chair, then (M) with (K), then (C) and (D).
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: This isolates (V), alone with (J) in the Elephant Habitat. Jim is the murderer!
